items.item_text: 01. How have you demonstrated sensitivity to and understanding of the diverse academic, socioeconomic, cultural, disability, geographic, gender, gender identity, and ethnic backgrounds of community college students?

02. Describe your experience administering student conduct processes in higher education. Provide a specific example of a complex student conduct matter you handled, including how you assessed the reported behavior, applied institutional policies and procedures, determined an appropriate resolution or recommended action, and balanced student accountability with educational and developmental outcomes.

03. Describe your experience administering or supporting Title IX compliance efforts in higher education. Provide a specific example demonstrating how you applied applicable laws, regulations, and institutional policies; addressed reports or complaints of sexual misconduct; and ensured equitable processes and protections for the individuals involved.

04. This position is responsible for managing multiple Title IX, student conduct, and behavioral intervention matters, often involving competing priorities and sensitive timelines. Describe your experience managing a complex caseload, including how you prioritize matters, monitor compliance deadlines, maintain accurate records, and ensure timely communication and follow-up.

05. Describe a prevention, awareness, or educational initiative you developed, coordinated, or facilitated related to Title IX, sexual misconduct, healthy relationships, student conduct, or campus safety. Explain the identified need, your role in planning and implementing the initiative, the audiences served, any campus partnerships involved, and how you evaluated its effectiveness.

06. Describe your experience interpreting and applying federal and state laws, regulations, and institutional policies related to student rights and responsibilities in higher education. Provide a specific example of how you navigated complex or overlapping regulatory requirements, institutional policies, or administrative procedures to ensure compliance and appropriate resolution of a matter.

07. I understand that a COMPLETE application packet is required for consideration, which includes the following: 1. A completed Coast Community College District Online Employment Application 2. A current resume (uploaded as a separate attachment - PDF recommended) 3. A cover letter (uploaded as a separate attachment - PDF recommended) 4. Responses to supplemental questions (clear and detailed responses required, as they will be carefully evaluated to determine the most qualified candidate(s) to be invited for an interview; please do not paste your resume, or put "see resume", or "N/A" or leave blank) Options: Yes | No

08. Please confirm that all responses provided in this application are your own original work and were not generated or assisted by artificial intelligence tools or software. By answering 'Yes,' you attest to the authenticity of your responses. Options: Yes | No

Must possess a Bachelor’s degree from an accredited institution in Education or Public Administration or related field and three (3) to five (5) years of related work experience. Must have at least one year of experience handling investigations related to student conduct, discrimination, harassment, or retaliation.
A Master’s degree from an accredited institution in a related field as noted above.

Evidence of demonstrated sensitivity to and understanding of the diverse academic, socioeconomic, cultural, disability, geographic, gender, gender identity, and ethnic backgrounds of community college students. (California Code of Regulations Title 553022; Education Code Section 87360; Coast Community College District EEO Plan)
